title: Secret Santa gifts under £10 UK: 9 ideas from real shops, prices checked
description: Secret Santa gifts under £10 from John Lewis, Superdrug and Dunelm: card games, Lego, chocolate and pamper sets, with today's prices.
intro:
**The best Secret Santa gift under £10 right now is a classic card game: Uno is £8.99 at John Lewis, down from £11.99, and suits almost anyone.** If you know nothing about the person, chocolate (Hotel Chocolat Salted Caramel Puddles, £8) or a small Lego Botanicals set (£9.74) are the other safest picks.

Every price below was checked on the retailer's own page on 1 November 2026. Office Secret Santa budgets are usually £5 to £10, so we've stuck firmly under £10.

body:
## How to choose a Secret Santa gift under £10

Secret Santa is hard because you often don't know the person well. A survey of UK office workers by the printer instantprint found that nearly half would spend £5 to £10, so that's the budget most groups set. Three rules make it much easier:

1. **Pick something that gets used up or played with.** Games, chocolate and toiletries rarely end up in a drawer. Novelty tat usually does.
2. **Avoid anything personal.** Skip clothing sizes, strong perfumes and joke gifts about someone's age, job or habits. At work, keep it something you'd be happy to see opened in front of everyone.
3. **Spend the budget on one decent thing.** A proper branded card game or a good bar of chocolate feels more generous than three cheap bits in a bag.

## The best picks by type of person

- **Don't know them at all:** Uno, Hotel Chocolat or the Baylis & Harding hand wash set. All three suit nearly everyone.
- **The competitive one:** Uno Show 'em No Mercy or Skip-Bo.
- **The desk-proud colleague:** Lego Botanicals Daisies or a Rubik's Cube.
- **The commuter:** the Allsorted puzzle book.
- **Him, if you're stuck:** the Baylis & Harding Black Pepper & Ginseng set.

## Where to shop for cheap Secret Santa gifts

**John Lewis** has the widest range of branded games, small Lego sets and chocolate under £10. Its small Lego sets also include a Creator Magical Unicorn and a Minecraft set for under £7 if your group skews younger.

**Superdrug** has cut lots of Christmas gift sets to well under £10, including big names like Nivea, Dove and Lynx. **Boots** has been running a 3 for 2 on Christmas gifts, with the cheapest item free. If you're buying for family too, adding your Secret Santa present to that basket can make it free, but compare the price elsewhere first.

If you're also buying for the rest of the family, our [Christmas gift guides](/christmas-gifts/) cover bigger budgets, and our [Lego advent calendar 2026 guide](/guides/lego-advent-calendar-2026/) and [beauty advent calendars guide](/guides/beauty-advent-calendars-2026/) are worth a look before they sell out.

## When to buy

Buy Secret Santa gifts in early to mid November. Small gifts under £10 rarely get much cheaper on Black Friday, and the best-value gift sets tend to sell out first. Buying now also leaves plenty of time for delivery before the office party.

### What is a good Secret Santa gift for £10?

Something branded that gets used: a card game such as Uno (£8.99), a bar of good chocolate, a small Lego set or a toiletries gift set. All the gifts on this page are £10 or less.

### Is £10 enough for Secret Santa?

Yes. £5 to £10 is the most common budget for office Secret Santas in the UK, and there's a good choice of branded gifts at that price.

### What should you not buy for Secret Santa?

Avoid anything too personal, rude or joke gifts about someone's looks or age, strong perfumes, food for someone whose diet you don't know, and unbranded novelty items that end up in the bin.

### Can you go over the Secret Santa budget?

Try not to. Going over makes everyone else's gift look small. Stick within a pound or so of the agreed limit.

### Where can I buy Secret Santa gifts cheaply?

John Lewis for games, Lego and chocolate, and Superdrug and Boots for toiletries gift sets, which are often discounted or part of 3 for 2 offers in November.
